paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of datasets by year, categorized into "Untargeted" and "Targeted" groups, from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, labeled in a linear sequence from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, marked at intervals of 20. Each year is represented by a pair of bars: "Untargeted" datasets are depicted in blue and "Targeted" datasets in orange. The height of each bar corresponds to the number of datasets for that category in a given year. The number of "Targeted" datasets consistently exceeds that of "Untargeted" ones across most years, with both categories showing an overall increase over time. Specifically, the number of "Targeted" datasets rises from 1 in 2012 to approximately 155 in 2021, with notable increases observed between 2018 and 2021. In contrast, "Untargeted" datasets grow from 0 in 2012 to around 65 in 2021. The data for 2022 is incomplete, as indicated by a lighter shade for both categories. The bars are grouped by year, with no specific sorting or visual emphasis applied to any particular year or category.
